newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.

text.p: * International Business Machines Corp shares fell 1-3/8 to 168 in after-hours trading Tuesday after the company reported fourth earnings of $3.93 per share, up from $3.09 a year ago. The First Call consensus was $3.88.
Some analysts were disappointed about sluggish mainframe sales.
* U.S. Robotics Corp stood at 74-1/4 in after-hours trading Tuesday, up from its close at 73-5/8.
The company reported fiscal first quarter earnings per share of $0.72, compared to $0.45 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $0.72.
* CoreStates Financial Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.95, compared to $0.96 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 51-1/2 Tuesday,
* Allegheny Teledyne Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.29, compared to $0.54 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 21-1/2.
* Compaq Computer Corp reported fourth quarter earnings of $1.64 a share. The First Call estimate was $1.53. A year earlier Compaq earned $1.17 per share, before an $0.87 charge.
